Vile Child (Demon) (Guest Monster)
Flesh Beast, Grotesque Wyrm

Ravenous from the very second of their birth, these fetid beasts swarm to any potential food source. Unfortunately, for their victims, this is usually an adventurer who has strayed too far from the safety of the Pandemonium Fortress.

Tips and Other Additional Information
Vile Children are very dangerous so it's a good idea to kill their Vile Mothers as soon as you can to prevent more of them from showing up.

Flesh Beasts have a chance to deal Cold damage.
Grotesque Wyrms have a chance to deal Poison damage.
